native_probe.scope:
Measure a real native CLI run without restoring complete facts in the observer.

Windows Job accounting includes every descendant. The explicit safety memory cap
is recorded; hitting it is a controlled failure, never labelled a natural OOM.
This harness does not establish semantic equivalence, a physical 32GB test, or
the complete G4 disk gate. File allocation is a sampled lower bound excluding
directory/MFT metadata and alternate data streams. Paging rates are host-wide.
native_probe.canonical_scope: Production CLI body, not TaskManager publication wrapper

strict_original_comparison.scope:
Strict ordered/typed native comparison without loading complete fact graphs.

Inputs must be full canonical graphs. Legacy JSON can be streamed into one by
publish_json_scan; original JSON/results are never modified. Only the existing
clean_report contract and explicitly documented execution envelope are removed
from the comparison hash. Every other field, order and duplicate is retained.
strict_original_comparison.large_native_G1: Requires matching independently native inputs and receipts; this tool alone is not G1
